With radical compassion, this is a Wellness Channel called Holistic Connection. We are passionate about helping, healing, and connecting to people through the Seven Pillars of Health. That is the foundation of Holistic Connection. We believe there are super powers in all of our healers and are ecstatic to show you how they can guide you to live your life to its fullest expression. Allow us to hold space and connect with you through our videos. 

Founder, Chris Delos Reyes offers his ten years of experience as a Registered Massage Therapist in Toronto, ON, Canada through his videos that elevate your Physical Pillar. 

Holistic Connection— Your Wellness Concierge
